version.description: Pins this module: X.Y.Z exactly, X.Y or X to the newest release within it. Omitted, the newest release (LIB-0023 §3).

additional_volume_ids.description: IDs of block volumes to attach. Created by the caller (ADR-0153, reversing ADR-0120's internal block-volume composition). Note the instance only mounts /dev/sdb if its cloud-init was rendered with has_attached_volume = true.

secretRef.description: A name in the workload secrets.yaml env map (LIB-0025)

cloud_init.description: Rendered cloud-init document for user_data["cloud-init"], normally compute-instance-config's cloud_init output. null attaches no user_data at all. Changing it replaces the instance.

secretRef.description: A name in the workload secrets.yaml env map (LIB-0025)

enable_private_network.description: Attach the instance to private_network_id with a standalone scaleway_instance_private_nic, so attaching or detaching never replaces the server (ADR-0145). An explicit bool rather than private_network_id != null, since count can't depend on an apply-time-unknown ID (compute-instance v5.6.0).

enabled.description: Whether to create the instance. false destroys the server only; any IP, volume or IAM the caller created for it is untouched.

project_id.description: Project the instance, and the IP public_ipv4 creates, live in (LIB-0043). Required since v8.0.0: the provider's own default project is rarely the one a caller means.

public_ipv4.description: Create a routed public IPv4 for the instance and attach it, beside any ip_ids (LIB-0043). The IP isn't gated by enabled, so it keeps its address across an enabled = false cycle. While a Public Gateway pushes its default route on the instance's Private Network, the IP works outbound only (ADR-0146).
